decision: Announced identity-only successor for P36 safe CPU affinity sets. The jope-campaigns nix sched dependency adds the safe CpuSet API and changes Cargo.lock. This transition also closes the unrecorded evaluator identity drift introduced by #1659, which was already red on origin/main. Evaluator calculations, DSL ABI, behavior fixtures, lineage source hashes, and historical identity rows are unchanged; lineage changes only generated_at_sha. No known-identity row is added without a shipped receipt.
plan_reference: P36 rust-bad-behavior cap; ADR-0004 and compat_freeze identity-only procedure
